description: A base fragment class for editing notes in an Android note-taking app. Manages loading, editing, saving, and UI interactions for notes.

classes.name: BaseNoteFragment
classes.description: Abstract fragment class providing core functionalities for note editing, such as loading, saving, menu handling, and interaction with note data.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Attaches the fragment and initializes the listener and repository.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes account, loads note data from saved state or arguments, updates UI.

methods.name: initializeAccount
methods.description: Retrieves the current account via SSO helper.

methods.name: loadFromSavedState
methods.description: Restores note state from saved instance state.

methods.name: loadFromArguments
methods.description: Loads note based on passed arguments, either existing or new.

methods.name: loadExistingNote
methods.description: Fetches an existing note by ID, potentially switching account context.

methods.name: createNewNote
methods.description: Creates a new note based on provided parameters.

methods.name: getScrollView
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to return the scroll view.

methods.name: scrollToY
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to scroll to a specific Y position.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Handles UI updates when fragment resumes.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Saves note state when fragment is paused.

methods.name: onDetach
methods.description: Cleans up references when fragment is detached.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves current note state for configuration changes.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates menu and adds pin shortcut option if supported.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares menu items based on note state.

methods.name: prepareFavoriteOption
methods.description: Updates menu icon aligned with note's favorite state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item actions such as delete, favorite, category, title, move, share, pin.

methods.name: pinNoteToHome
methods.description: Pins note as shortcut on home screen if supported.

methods.name: shareNote
methods.description: Shares note content via system share dialog.

methods.name: onNoteLoaded
methods.description: Initializes scroll position and scroll change listener.

methods.name: onScroll
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to react to scroll events.

methods.name: shouldShowToolbar
methods.description: Determines toolbar visibility.

methods.name: onCloseNote
methods.description: Deletes note if unchanged or clears state on closing.

methods.name: saveNote
methods.description: Saves current note state and initiates sync.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve note content from UI.

methods.name: showCategorySelector
methods.description: Displays category selection dialog.

methods.name: showEditTitleDialog
methods.description: Displays dialog to edit note title.

methods.name: onCategoryChosen
methods.description: Callback when category is selected, updates note.

methods.name: onTitleEdited
methods.description: Callback when title is changed, updates note.

methods.name: moveNote
methods.description: Transfers note to another account.
